attBesluta.text: Excelente produto, satisfez as minhas expectativas.

I'm 83 and have 17 steep steps up to my apartment. I've purchased 2 other (more expensive) carts because carrying the groceries, etc. up the stairs has become quite difficult. Neither of them did the job. I purchased your Stair Climber and it's great! It does the stairs remarkably easily and is so light that taking it down is a breeze. I don't think it's hyperbole to day it's made my continued independence possible.
It works great, easy to use and great for getting up stairs
